scope: Disposable kind Kubernetes v1.36.1 cluster. Tests namespace-scoped Deployment authorization with a short-lived fixture ServiceAccount token, then a ValidatingAdmissionPolicy parameterized by a protected namespace-local ConfigMap promotion record. Deployments have zero replicas and inert images. A separate namespace and private TLS registry isolate the actual runtime pull authorization comparison.
